CARDINAL DAVID: TO THE STREETS 

LOOK: Pablo Virgilio Cardinal David, Bishop of Kalookan and president of the Catholic Bishops' Conference of the Philippines urged Filipinos to join a second Trillion Peso March in Manila on Nov. 30, Bonifacio Day. 

The first Trillion Peso March was held in the capital and other places such as Cebu City on Sept. 21 to protest against rampant corruption in the government particularly in anomalous flood mitigation projects. | 📽️ Caritas Philippines via Jason Baguia #CDNDigital
